description: On a dynaset over R: AddNew; assign ID 1, Cd 'r1', Rq Null and Vv -5 (the same four violations); Update; CancelUpdate. Asks which call reports which violation and how many Errors entries are left. Sequence on a fresh copy of the main fixture opened writable as db: the setup calls (recorded); Errors read (Count, then Number, Description, Source, HelpContext and HelpFile of each member in order); the step; Errors read; a snapshot OpenRecordset of 'SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY ID'; Errors read; the same step again; Errors read; the snapshot and the objects of the setup closed. Each call's HRESULT, EXCEPINFO and IErrorInfo are in its own call record. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
